description: Unsigned transactions to invest an amount of USDC in one Sjothr raise, from the contract's own quote: the USDC allowance, then the purchase. The 10% fee is paid by the backer on top of the amount. To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

amount.description: USDC that go to the round vault, digits with an optional decimal point, for example 25.5

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

name: sjothr_prepare
title: Prepare an investment in a Sjothr raise
